test_thread_session_starts_empty: test that a new DM thread session starts empty without inheriting the parent's transcript
test_parent_transcript_unaffected_by_thr: test that creating a thread session does not alter the parent session's transcript
test_multiple_threads_are_independent: test that multiple threads from the same parent session stay independent
test_existing_thread_session_preserved: test that re-accessing an existing thread session does not reset its transcript
test_thread_starts_empty_across_platform: test that DM thread sessions start empty across Slack, Telegram, and Discord platforms
